source_tags.wheelchair:description: lift door opens on N side at ground and platform levels; on E side at intermediate level
lift door opens on N side intermediate and platform levels; on E side at ground level
lift door opens on N side intermediate and platform levels; on W side at ground level
Wide barrier. Direct lifts from South Bank riverside walkway to platforms 1 or 2/3. Change lifts midway for platform 4. 90 degree turn in lifts for exit.
Step-free exit from both Northern line platforms via passage & lift.
Viewpoint and sign with description. Just west of sign for Wheelchair route to London Bridge.
Overground platforms Step-free to train. Jubilee: Step-free access street to train.
On south wall in subway under Southwark Bridge. NOT directly step-free from the bridge, gentle slope route via Park Street & Bear Garden.
Angle of sloping gangway to pontoon varies according to the tide. Can be very steep, but otherwise step-free.
Step at entrance, very narrow, high tables, toilets downstairs
The front of the pub is accessible, there rear is not. No wheelchair accessible toilets, though.
Step-free entrances, ramp down to Turbine Hall. Lifts to all levels including Switch House panorama level 10. Many accessible toilets.

Steps at west door near accessible toilet, accessible entrance on north side, or church yard. Lift* from Lancelot Link to Cathedral nave, some areas via steps only. Hearing Loop. (* being repaired 9/2018)
Ramp to outside seating. Wide doors, some seating inside is NOT step free. Accessible toilet near bar =RADAR key.
